current_evidence: The council's 'Planning application validation requirements' download page lists only this Local Validation Checklist (id 8022), and its cover reads 'Adopted May 2018 / Reviewed May 2026'.

issues.detail: About half of the list's 30 numbered local requirements are not captured. Missing: Affordable Housing Statement (residential 11+ dwellings or >1,000 sq m gross); Agricultural Land Quality Assessment (all major applications on greenfield land); Air Quality Mitigation Statement (any application increasing vehicle movements, excluding householder); BREEAM Statement (non-residential >1,000 sq m); Contaminated Land Survey (land likely to be contaminated or affected by contamination); Design Statement (major residential 200+ units or >10,000 sq m); Environmental Impact Assessment (Schedule 1 or positively screened Schedule 2); Foul Sewerage/Utilities Statement (development not relying solely on public sewer connection); Heritage Statement (development affecting designated heritage assets incl. conservation areas, listed and locally listed buildings); Housing/Local Needs Survey (where local need is the justification); Lighting/Light Pollution Assessment (floodlighting proposals, captured only as an advert item); Noise/Vibration Impact Assessment (noisy uses beside existing uses, or residential beside noise sources); Open Space Statement (residential 11+ units); Ventilation/Extraction Details (any new ventilation/extraction equipment); Visitor Accommodation Assessment (loss of visitor accommodation).
issues.evidence: Local Validation List (Reviewed May 2026), numbered items 1, 2, 3, 7, 9, 10, 12, 14, 15, 17, 19, 21, 22, 28, 30

issues.detail: The Flood Risk Assessment trigger is the EIA trigger text ('All development in Schedule 1 of the Regulations or positively screened development in Schedule 2'). The real FRA trigger is Flood Zones 2/3 (including minor development and change of use), sites over 1 ha in Flood Zone 1, smaller Zone 1 sites with more vulnerable uses or other flood sources, and critical drainage areas.
issues.evidence: Item 13 Flood Risk Assessment: Flood Zones 2 or 3; >1 ha in Zone 1; 'Flood Zones plus Climate Change'

issues.detail: The Energy/Sustainability Statement trigger is Design Statement content (street hierarchy, development blocks, massing). The real trigger is all development (Policy CC1), with Net Zero Carbon DPD policies NZC1/NZC2 for 1+ dwellings or non-residential 1,000 sq m+, NZC3 embodied carbon for majors, and whole-life assessment for 50+ dwellings or 5,000 sq m+.
issues.evidence: Item 11 Energy Statement (Warwick Net Zero Carbon DPD)

issues.detail: 'Planning Obligations / S106 draft Heads of Terms' quotes clauses from a template S106 deed ('2.1 The Planning Obligations are planning obligations for the purposes of Section 106...'), not a trigger. In the list, legal agreements/heads of terms appear under 'Recommended Additional Documents', not as a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: Recommended Additional Documents: 'Legal Agreements (s.106): draft heads of terms, cost agreement, solicitor details, draft Unilateral Undertaking'

issues.detail: 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' is mislabelled. The quoted text is the town-centre Impact Assessment / Sequential Test (office, retail, leisure etc. above 500 sq m, or 2,500 sq m for offices, outside town centres), not the flood sequential test.

Several triggers are fragments with no threshold. Transport Assessment ('required in a transport assessment, please see here.') should be major applications generating significant traffic. Ecology ('of follow-on bat survey may be necessary prior to validation.') should be PEA for minor and major applications likely to affect protected species, plus PRA for demolition, loft-void works or mature trees. CIL ('All applications which: i.') should be new dwellings, retail/student housing >100 sq m, or residential extensions >100 sq m. Archaeology omits the site triggers (Scheduled Monument, listed building, registered park/battlefield, sites >0.2 ha). Parking ('a RPZ, a parking survey will also be required...') omits the Parking Standards SPD trigger. BNG omits the major/small-site scope.
issues.evidence: Items 4, 5, 6, 8, 23, 26 of the Local Validation List

issues.detail: Householder is marked '(none) - national requirements only', but several list items apply to householder schemes. Tree Survey covers all development affecting trees; Heritage Statement covers development affecting listed buildings and conservation areas; FRA covers Flood Zones 2/3 including minor development; PRA covers works to non-inhabited loft voids; CIL Form 1 covers residential extensions over 100 sq m; Ventilation/Extraction covers any new equipment. Listed building consent is likewise marked '(none)' although the Heritage Statement applies.
issues.evidence: Item 3 Air Quality expressly 'excluding householders' (showing the list does cover householder); item 8 CIL 'residential extensions over 100 sq m'

issues.detail: About 20 rows carry 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Many are major-only (Housing Mix Statement, BNG major/small sites, Transport Assessment, unallocated parking plan for 10+ dwellings) and could equally apply to outline. Outline and Reserved matters are left as '(none)' even though the major-scheme items (Affordable Housing, Housing Mix, Open Space, Transport Assessment, Energy Statement) apply to them.
issues.evidence: Example rows: 'Housing mix ... Major residential applications', 'Highways / access details' - all INFERRED Full planning

issues.detail: Several captured items are recommendations or advice rather than validation requirements. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Water efficiency' come from 'Recommended Additional Documents (not required for validation)'. The Water efficiency trigger is in any case garbled ('Water Efficiency 32 What Document?...'). 'Structural Survey' (Class Q) is also from the recommended section. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is a recommendation to consult WCC Ecological Services. 'Design and Access Statement' is a national requirement.
issues.evidence: Recommended Additional Documents: 'Drainage details', 'SUDS/Water Efficiency Statement', 'Structural Survey' - not required for validation

issues.detail: 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' is mislabelled. The text is the item 23 unallocated parking plan (20% unallocated parking for 10+ dwellings with new adoptable highway), not visibility splays.
issues.evidence: Item 23: 'Plan demonstrating provision of 20% of the total allocated parking space provision as unallocated parking'

issues.detail: Tab items include process text and fragments with stray page numbers, for example 'Any hard copy certificate ... must be signed by hand', 'Submit all plans at A4 or A3 size where possible 6.' and 'Annotate dimensions, where appropriate More information can be found here.'

summary: Grokbot's link and date are correct: the Local Validation List was adopted May 2018 and reviewed May 2026, and it is the only list on the council's validation page. The extraction misses about 15 of 30 local requirements (Affordable Housing, Heritage Statement, Air Quality, Noise, Contaminated Land, BREEAM, Open Space and others), copies the EIA and Design Statement text into the FRA and Energy triggers, mislabels the retail sequential test as a flood test, and leaves Householder empty.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
